brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure because the unit is of advanced age and cannot be attended before the event (MG-023). Reduce permissible load by 1.5 percent of rating for each degree of average ambient above 30 degrees, assessed over the 24 hours preceding the loading decision (MG-021). On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward (MG-021).
